portal.hdrSubtitlePh: e.g. Your registration, payment and program in one place
portal.firmIdentityHint: Can be added in Settings → Company Identity.

install.title: Install the app
install.desc: Add to your home screen and use it like a native app.

b2b.reschedDesc: Briefly tell the organizer which times suit you.

done.RESCHEDULE: Your time request has been sent

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestDesc: If you have registered, you can sign in with the details sent in your e-mail.
profile.registerDesc: The registration form is still open — apply in minutes.
profile.guestRights: As a guest you can see the agenda, speakers, sponsors and floor plans. Identity-based voting, your personal B2B calendar and ticket details are available to registered participants.
profile.noRegs: No registrations — you have not created one yet.
profile.notifDesc: Session and appointment reminders ({offsets} min before) are delivered here.
profile.notifTestBody: You will see event reminders here.

reminder.disabledDesc: The organizer has disabled reminders for this event.

login.emailHint: Sign in with the address on your invitation e-mail to access tickets and B2B meetings.
login.codeHint: Enter with the event code shared by the organizer — the agenda, speakers and sponsors open up.

countdown.maintenance: The portal is under maintenance — please try again shortly.

notifCenter.title: Notifications
notifCenter.emptyAnn: No announcements yet — new ones will appear here.
notifCenter.emptyRem: No planned reminders. Tap "Remind me" on a session in the agenda.

access.title: Access & Security Management
access.desc: Portal status, entry code and magic link management.
access.statusOn: Portal is active — participants can sign in.
access.statusOff: Portal is inactive — a maintenance message or countdown is shown.
access.maintPh: e.g. The portal is briefly under maintenance…
access.codeHint: Guest and e-mail entry open with this code. Empty disables code entry.
access.magicHint: Issues personal, single-display access keys for registered participants.
access.regRedirectHint: Shows the registration form button on the login screen and guest profile.

brand.title: Visual Configuration & Theme
brand.desc: Portal logo, banner, theme color and menu customization.
brand.headerSubtitlePh: e.g. Registration, program and B2B in one place
brand.headerEventsHint: Selected events appear in the top strip carousel for portal visitors. If empty, all published events are shown.
brand.bottomNavHint: Home and Profile are fixed; you can hide the others.
brand.imgSize: Image is too large — max {kb} KB

widgets.title: Dynamic Widget & Module Management
widgets.desc: Toggle home cards, assign visibility, reorder.
widgets.b2bLocked: B2B is locked to registered users by design

notify.title: Notification Management
notify.desc: Reminder triggers and the live announcement panel.
notify.enabledHint: Notifications are sent for B2B appointments and reminder-marked sessions.
notify.offsetsHint: How many minutes before the event/appointment the notification fires. Up to 5 triggers.

announce.title: Live Announcement Panel
announce.desc: Send instant announcements to all active portal users.
announce.titlePh: e.g. Coffee break has started in the main hall
announce.sentDesc: It reaches users with the portal open instantly.
announce.distribNone: No external channel delivery — WhatsApp/SMS channels are off or no phone recipients found.

content.title: Content Mapping
content.desc: Choose sponsors and the floor plan shown on the portal — data is not copied, it is linked to existing records.
content.sponsorsSelected: {count} sponsors selected — only selected ones appear on the portal
content.sponsorsAll: None selected — all active sponsors are shown
content.pwaHint: When PWA is on, the portal can be installed as an app on mobile browsers (add to home screen + offline shell).

analytics.title: Live Portal Statistics
analytics.desc: Unique visitors, widget clicks, PWA installs, form and B2B metrics.

magic.title: Magic Link / Access Code Generation
magic.desc: A personal access key is issued for each selected participant.
magic.onceWarning: Keys are shown ONCE only — copy and share them via a secure channel.
magic.sendMail: Also send via the mail module

design.title: Design & Typography
design.desc: All mobile portal design settings: font, area colors, background images (SVG/PNG/JPEG), sponsor logo and icon positions.
design.fontPreview: Headings and text across the mobile portal render with this font.
design.fontScaleHint: 100% is default; scales all portal text between 90–120%.
design.areaColorsHint: If left empty, that area falls back to the default theme color.
design.headerImgHint: Covered behind the top header and event title.
design.footerImgHint: Covered behind the fixed bottom nav.
design.sponsorDesc: Enter logo, name and web link — the sponsor strip appears above the bottom nav on all screens.
design.canvasDesc: Drag bottom-nav icons on the grid to reposition them; upload an SVG logo for any icon.
design.canvasHint: Drag & drop or use the arrows · You can upload an SVG (or PNG) logo for the selected icon.

channels.title: Notification Channels — WhatsApp & SMS
channels.desc: Send notifications via WhatsApp and SMS through the connected company mobile phone. Secrets are stored encrypted and shown masked.
channels.masterHint: When off, no WhatsApp/SMS is sent; in-app notifications are unaffected.
channels.waDesc: Sent through a provider connected to the company mobile phone.
channels.smsDesc: SMS channel for announcements and reminders.
channels.demoNote: The demo provider never hits the network, it simulates the flow — pick a real provider in production.
channels.waFromHint: Company mobile number connected to WhatsApp (E.164).

questions.title: Q&A Moderation
questions.desc: Reply to or hide portal questions; replies appear in the participant question history.
